request: Fix the phase-timing instrument in .claude/hooks/lib/timing.mjs: (1) anchor the run-start baseline row at wf.created_at * 1000 instead of now(), so phase 1 stops reporting zero elapsed; (2) mark batch-stamped rows with batch_id + batch_size so consumers distinguish 'nothing happened' from 'not observed'; (3) add approve-direction to GATE_PHASES, resolve the approval-token path for the renamed gate, and store wait_ms per row so consent-gate wait is a field rather than an inference.
novelty_evidence: Defect 2 is documented in landmines.md → phase-timer-collapses-phases-appended-in-one-workflow-json-write. Defect 3 traces to commit b887f74 (D3/CO-E gate rename approve-spec → approve-direction) which never propagated to lib/timing.mjs GATE_PHASES or approvalTokenPath. Defect 1 read directly from lib/timing.mjs → stampFromWorkflow, which pushes the baseline row with ts = now() while using createdMs only for the token anchor. Measured on .claude/state/timing/: 55 of 55 instrumented runs show run-start.ts == first-phase.ts (zero-duration phase 1); 105 of 729 stamped rows (14.4%) are batch-collapsed, concentrated in tdd (78%) and tdd:finalize (85%).
